title: A cocrystallization of polyoxotitanium cages with lanthanide clusters

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: hexahydrogen dodecatitanium octadecaisopropoxide tetradeca-μ3-oxo tris(lanthanum) undecanitrate hexaisopropoxide cocrystal

material_class.structural_family: cocrystal of Ti12 polyoxotitanium cation and La3 nitrate/isopropoxide cluster anion

synthesis.procedure: La(NO3)3·xH2O (1245 mg, 3.0 mmol) was dissolved in water-free isopropanol (30 mL) with vigorous stirring until completely digested, then Ti(OiPr)4 (3.7 mL, 12.0 mmol) was added slowly. After standing at room temperature for 3 days, colorless crystals of compound 1 were obtained (40% yield based on Ti).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: colorless crystals formed from the reaction mixture after standing

properties.summary: Solid-state UV–vis/diffuse-reflectance spectra of 1 are transparent in 400–800 nm (near-colorless crystals). Absorption onset 355 nm; optical band gap 3.49 eV by Kubelka–Munk, slightly lower than undoped [Ti12O16(OiPr)16] (3.51 eV), assigned to O(p)→Ti(d).

measurements.name: diffuse reflectance absorption onset
measurements.conditions: solid-state DRS, crystalline powder ground in a glove box and sealed between quartz windows

measurements.name: optical band gap
measurements.conditions: Kubelka–Munk evaluation of solid-state diffuse reflectance

source_locations.location: TAJPAZ01/1815389 and TAJPAZ02/1558762 matching the Ti12/La3 ion-pair formula

synthesis.procedure: The same reagent mixture used for 1 (La(NO3)3·xH2O, 1245 mg, 3.0 mmol; water-free isopropanol, 30 mL; Ti(OiPr)4, 3.7 mL, 12.0 mmol) was heated under reflux at 120 °C for 12 h, giving colorless crystals of compound 2 (88% yield based on Ti).

properties.summary: Compound 2 is transparent in 400–800 nm. Diffuse-reflectance onset 381 nm; optical band gap 3.25 eV (Kubelka–Munk), lower than undoped Ti12 (3.51 eV) and closer to TiO2 (3.20 eV), associated with O(p)→Ti(d).

measurements.name: diffuse reflectance absorption onset
measurements.conditions: solid-state DRS, crystalline powder ground in a glove box and sealed between quartz windows

measurements.name: optical band gap
measurements.conditions: Kubelka–Munk evaluation of solid-state diffuse reflectance

source_locations.location: Section 2.2 CCDC 2039973 (paired with 1815389 for the two Ln-POTs)
